suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as disease complication. Require documented CKD and independently documented anemia. Do not infer anemia from CKD stage alone, and do not exclude evaluation for other clinically relevant causes of anemia. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.

suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-4 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Require documented chronic kidney disease and a separately established diagnosis of heart failure/congestive heart failure. Treat the source as population-level incident-risk evidence, not proof that chronic kidney disease caused heart failure in an individual. Preserve competing cardiac causes and contributors, including ischemic heart disease, hypertension, valvular disease, cardiomyopathy, arrhythmia, and volume-status factors. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent documentation of chronic-kidney-disease and congestive-heart-failure
Chronology and phenotype compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of competing etiologies, shared risk factors, and treatment effects where applicable

Resolution of the approved publication guard: Require documented chronic kidney disease and a separately established diagnosis of heart failure/congestive heart failure. Preserve competing cardiac causes and contributors, including ischemic heart disease, hypertension, valvular disease, cardiomyopathy, arrhythmia, and volume-status factors.
